svg.title: Several residents and two staff members at a shelter develop sudden vomiting and diarrhea, and norovirus is suspected. Select all appropriate control measures.
svg.desc: Norovirus resists alcohol, so soap and running water and a bleach solution are the measures that work. Food handlers stay out for at least 48 hours after symptoms resolve because shedding continues. Antibiotics do nothing against a virus, and hand gel is at best an add-on, never a replacement.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Communicable Disease
Read the situation
Several residents and two staff members at
a shelter develop sudden vomiting and
diarrhea, and norovirus is suspected.
Select all appropriate control measures.
What fits here
Have everyone wash with soap and running
water rather than rely on hand gel ·
Disinfect bathrooms and surfaces with a
chlorine bleach solution · Keep staff who
prepare food off duty until…
Why it fits
Norovirus resists alcohol, so soap and
running water and a bleach solution are
the measures that work. Food handlers stay
out for at least 48 hours after symptoms
resolve because shedding continues.
Antibiotics do nothing against a virus,
and hand gel is at best an add-on, never a
replacement.
